V001.text: 3 Navratri looks, each with its own kind of power. Purple celebrates Goddess Mahagauri symbolizing purity, peace and serenity with sparkling zirconia stones bringing a regal charm. And peacock green represents Goddess Siddhidhatri, associated with wisdom, spiritual fulfillment and divine blessings. A beautiful way to end these 9 days. At the Amethyst tour, every piece is handcrafted in India using generational techniques with 92.5 sterling silver dipped in 24 karat gold plating.
